bullets.text: Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided public research abstracts with subject labels and bibliographic metadata; edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied scikit-learn notebook procedures comparing dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration; examined topic stability across repeated fits and inspected documents supporting each interpretation.
